title: LTA — Annual Report 2025 participation growth
scope: Official LTA 2025 participation summary with record adult and child tennis participation.
limitations: Participation measures include both sexes and are current-period survey indicators rather than a historical annual series or quality measure. Earth code GBR is the United Kingdom, while LTA/Great Britain tennis remit is not a perfect political-territory match (notably Northern Ireland, and LTA inclusion of Channel Islands/Isle of Man); this source is therefore an explicit association-remit proxy rather than a literal UK census.
